extraction_notes: Main-text performance digitisation from Figure 1 only. The grey thermodynamic-equilibrium curves/open symbols in Figure 1 were skipped as equilibrium/simulated references. Figure 3 is characterization and was skipped. Figure 4A,B are kinetic model-fit parity plots rather than performance versus a process variable, and Figure 4C is isotope MS signal, so these were not digitised as ammonia synthesis performance records. Feed ratio, flow, catalyst mass and space velocity were not available in the supplied main text/captions.
